```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)

```


# Load Data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_excel(here("Data", "Raw", "Metadata", "GPH_metadata_completo.xlsx"))
viromeqc <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "ViromeQC", "ViromeQC_all_reports.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```



# Cleaning df

```{r df cleaning}

metadata <- metadata %>%
  # A missing PDI means the FFQ was discarded for implausible total energy intake,
  # so this is the questionnaire quality filter, not a filter on the index itself.
  filter(!is.na(PDI)) %>%
  transmute(sample_id = gsub("-","_", record_id),
         diet_group = case_when(
           patrondietet == 1 ~ "Omnivore",
           patrondietet == 2 ~ "Vegetarian",
           patrondietet == 3 ~ "Vegan"),
         sex = case_when(
           sexo == 0 ~ "Female",
           sexo == 1 ~ "Male",
           sexo == 2 ~ "Other"),
         height = talla,
         weight = peso,
         age = edad,
         metabolic_age = edad_metab,
         bmi = imc)
```


# Sequencing depth

```{r viromeqc}
viromeqc <- viromeqc %>%
  transmute(sample_id = gsub("_hostclean_R1", "", Sample),
            reads = Reads) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% metadata$sample_id)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(viromeqc, by = "sample_id")

cat("Samples:", nrow(metadata), "| without reads:", sum(is.na(metadata$reads)), "\n")
```

# Save results
```{r save results}
write_tsv(metadata, here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"))
```
